description: US EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report data from the official EIA Open Data API: commercial crude, SPR, Cushing, gasoline, distillate, jet fuel and propane stocks, crude production, imports, exports, total and gasoline product supplied (demand) and refinery utilization. Latest week, week-over-week change and recent history per series; units as published (thousand barrels, thousand b/d, %). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

series.description: Comma list of crudeStocks, sprStocks, gasolineStocks, distillateStocks, jetFuelStocks, propaneStocks, crudeProduction, crudeImports, crudeExports, productSupplied, gasolineSupplied, refineryUtilization, cushingStocks (default: all), or raw EIA series ids like WCESTUS1

name: energy_eia_weekly_petroleum
title: Energy Eia Weekly Petroleum
